title: Taxi Quest
tagline: Ride flying taxis driven by wild animals and do their ridiculous favours, from a crocodile's first meal in forty years to a bank job with a gorilla.
controls: Mouse and keyboard. Touch works too.

made.prompt: new repo, make a browser based game. one shot it until it is fun and playable. Make a first person RPG game for the browser, where you go on amazing and quirky rides in taxis. The drivers are wild animals and make you do quests like rob a bank, get a happy meal, save a child, and so on. based in a sci fi city and taxis can fly.
